core_principles: Context is King: Conversion-focused local medical practice. The path to booking (Termin vereinbaren) must be frictionless.
Solid Surfaces: Avoid glassmorphism to prevent a cold, clinical feel. Use flat, warm solid backgrounds with subtle borders.
Generous Spacing: Use breathing room (padding) heavily to convey calm and luxury (e.g., Wahlarzt premium feel).
Human Touch: Rely on real uploaded photos. Ensure image slots are defined with appropriate object-fit and max-height constraints.

typography.guidelines: Headlines MUST use tracking-tight equivalent (letter-spacing: -0.02em) and line-height: 1.1. Body uses line-height: 1.6. No center alignment for multi-line text; left-align paragraphs for readability.

spacing_and_layout.layout_rules: Use a mobile-first approach. Container max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding-inline: var(--space-4). Sections must have padding-block of var(--space-20) to var(--space-32) on desktop, var(--space-12) on mobile. Use pure CSS Grid for complex layouts.

header.structure: Sticky navigation, z-index 50. Solid white background with a subtle border-bottom (1px solid var(--color-border)). Logo on left, Nav links center, Accessibility toggle + 'Termin' CTA on right.
header.interactions: Nav links hover state: color changes to var(--color-primary). Active state styling.

hero.structure: Relative container. Background: uploaded photo (e.g., AKV.jpg). Overlay: div covering 100% width/height with `background: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(128, 204, 40, 0.98) 0%, rgba(128, 204, 40, 0.85) 45%, rgba(128, 204, 40, 0.1) 100%);`.
hero.content: Left-aligned content. H1 (var(--text-5xl)), Subtitle (var(--text-2xl)), 3 checkmark list items, primary CTA 'Termin vereinbaren' + 'Keine Kassen' badge (Navy background, white text, rounded-full). All text white for contrast.
hero.media_slot: Requires real photo uploaded by user. Ensure container has min-height: 85vh, background-size: cover, background-position: center right.

advantages_strip.structure: Full-width strip immediately below hero. Background: var(--color-secondary) (Navy). Text: White.
advantages_strip.content: CSS Grid layout for 4 items inline (desktop) or stacked (mobile). Headline 'Wir helfen Ihnen schnell weiter' plus 4 check items. Icons must be light green (#80cc28).

about_section.structure: CSS Grid bento/asymmetric layout (1 column mobile, 2 columns desktop). Column 1: Doctor/Practice text content. Column 2: Uploaded practice photo.
about_section.style: Image wrapper must have `object-fit: cover`, `border-radius: 12px` (subtle roundness). `max-height: 80vh`. Text side needs generous padding and gap (var(--space-8)).

services_grid.structure: CSS Grid `grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr))`; gap: var(--space-8). 6 Cards total.
services_grid.card_style: Flat surface (var(--color-surface)), 1px solid var(--color-border), border-radius: 8px. Padding: var(--space-8). Hover state: `transform: translateY(-4px)`, `box-shadow: 0 12px 24px rgba(30,58,95,0.06)`.
services_grid.content: Lucide Icon (Green, 32px), Title (Navy, var(--text-xl)), short description text (Muted Slate, var(--text-base)).

fees_section.structure: 3 info blocks layout using CSS Grid. Background: var(--color-surface-alt) (Soft Sage) spanning full width.
fees_section.content: Clear, transparent pricing info for Wahlarzt. Include large readable numbers or distinct visual icons. Title (var(--text-3xl)).

appointment_section.structure: Call-to-action banner. Background: var(--color-primary). Text: White. Center aligned content.
appointment_section.content: Headline (var(--text-4xl)), Subheadline, Online booking CTA button (White bg, Green text), Phone number link below CTA.

contact_faq.structure: CSS Grid, Two column layout on desktop (`grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr`). Left: Contact info, Open hours, Address. Right: FAQ accordion.
contact_faq.accordion_style: Vanilla JS toggle. Border-bottom on each `.faq-item`. Chevron icon rotates 180deg on open. Content uses `display: grid; grid-template-rows: 0fr;` transitioning to `1fr`.
contact_faq.map_style: Embedded map image or iframe. 100% width, `border-radius: 8px`, `aspect-ratio: 16/9`, `object-fit: cover`.

footer.structure: 3-column CSS Grid. Background: var(--color-secondary) (Navy). Text: #9CA3AF (Light gray).
footer.content: Col 1: Practice info, Col 2: Contact, Col 3: Legal links. Add a bottom border and copyright text below.

mobile_sticky_buttons.structure: Position: fixed bottom-0 left-0 width: 100% z-index: 50. Display: flex. Visible only via media query max-width: 768px.
mobile_sticky_buttons.buttons: Left button: Call (var(--color-secondary)), Right button: Booking (var(--color-primary)). Both: `flex: 1`, centered text, `padding: var(--space-4)`.

css_classes_patterns.btn_primary: background-color: var(--color-primary); color: #fff; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.2s ease; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;
css_classes_patterns.btn_secondary: background-color: transparent; color: var(--color-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--color-secondary); padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.2s ease;

motion_and_interactions.buttons: Hover states must have background color shift and a subtle transform (e.g., scale 1.02).
motion_and_interactions.cards: Services cards elevate slightly on hover (`transform: translateY(-4px)`) with an updated subtle box-shadow.
motion_and_interactions.accordions: CSS transition on `grid-template-rows` from 0fr to 1fr for smooth opening.
motion_and_interactions.links: Underline animation on hover for inline text links.

media_guidelines.images: User will supply real photos. Use class wrappers around `` elements with `object-fit: cover` and appropriate aspect ratios. Suggest adding placeholder blocks styled with a light gray background and dashed border to indicate where user should drop their images.
media_guidelines.icons: Use Lucide icons via CDN script (`<script src='https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest'></script>`). Ensure icon sizing aligns with text size (usually `width: 24px; height: 24px`).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text combinations meet WCAG AA standards. White text on Primary Green gradient MUST have enough opacity (e.g., 0.95 at start) or a subtle text-shadow if needed.
accessibility.existing_mode: Preserve the logic and button for the user's existing accessibility high-contrast toggle. Do not rewrite their accessibility JS logic, just style the trigger cleanly in the header.
accessibility.focus_states: All interactive elements must have a visible focus outline: `outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px;`
accessibility.testing: Add `data-testid` attribute to all key interactive elements (e.g., `data-testid='book-appointment-btn'`).

instructions_to_main_agent.architecture: Implement as pure HTML, CSS, and Vanilla JS. Create `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `main.js`.
instructions_to_main_agent.css_strategy: Set up CSS Variables (`:root`) exactly as defined in this JSON. Use standard CSS techniques (Grid/Flexbox). DO NOT use Tailwind CSS or any external framework other than Google Fonts (`Outfit` and `Work Sans`) and Lucide icon CDN.
instructions_to_main_agent.js_strategy: Write clean Vanilla JS for sticky header scroll effect, mobile menu toggle, FAQ accordion logic, and Lucide icons initialization `lucide.createIcons();`.
instructions_to_main_agent.image_handling: Since user uploads their own images, provide clear standard `` tags but apply strict CSS classes to them so they don't break layouts regardless of dimensions uploaded.
